summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Guardian Shield (Seraph Secure copy). Windows app pytest suite passes (10/10). Backend pytest: 12/13 passed. Frontend Playwright: all critical flows pass (nav, hero download, link checker presets + manual + copy, alert overlay with 3s disabled close, install tabs, FAQ accordion, mobile 390px no horizontal scroll).

minor.issue: 'VIRUS DETECTED call Microsoft Support 1-888-555-0199' classified as 'suspicious' (score 45) but review spec expects 'dangerous'. Hits virus(15) + call-support(15) + toll-free(15) = 45, below the 60 threshold. Consider raising per-rule points, lowering the 60 threshold, or adding a 'virus + call + phone-number' combined bonus to push these clear scam combos into 'dangerous'.

action_items: Tune link-checker scoring so classic combo 'virus warning + call support + toll-free number' reaches 'dangerous' verdict (currently stops at 'suspicious' with score 45; threshold is 60).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: build_zip() is CPU-bound and runs synchronously inside an async endpoint, blocking the event loop on each /api/download. Consider running it in a thread (await asyncio.to_thread(build_zip)) and/or caching the zip bytes with a mtime key since source rarely changes.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); FastAPI recommends lifespan context managers.
/api/check always bumps stats before validation; empty text still counts as a check. Minor, acceptable.
Pydantic max_length=5000 on CheckRequest is good; no rate limiting present (acceptable for MVP, no auth).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py cover all 4 endpoints incl. zip contents, stats increments, and parametrized verdicts. Windows pytest at /app/windows_app/tests. Only known failing assertion: the 'VIRUS DETECTED call Microsoft Support 1-888-555-0199' sample is classified 'suspicious' (score 45) rather than 'dangerous' - this is a scoring tune issue in /app/windows_app/guardian_shield/linkcheck.py, not an infra bug.
